segments.title: May
segments.text: Hello Kenkere House! May is Home for the Holidays. Students are back, mums are celebrated, and the studio has afternoons that are suspiciously quiet. This month we fill those quiet hours, and keep April's party guests from turning into ghosts.

segments.title: ₹11.34L
segments.text: So, the number. Our May target for Kenkere House is 11.3 lakh rupees. That's 15 per cent more than last May. Ambitious, yes. Unreasonable, no.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 6.01 lakh rupees. That's 5 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 3.86 lakh, everything else 79,400, and comebacks 68,000. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 57 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 847 leads, 305 trials, and 57 buyers, with about 19 per cent of trials converting. Every five trials should become about one member. Make those first classes unforgettable.

Here's where the offers come in. Four offers carry 3.95 lakh rupees, which is 35 per cent of our target. The rest comes from full-price sales, so the offers are a boost, not a crutch. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Mom-entum
segments.text: First up, for Mother's Day, Mom-entum. Mother and child duos get a duo private and a gift for mum, and newcomers get fifteen per cent off their first month. She carried you for nine months. You can carry her to class. The plan is 4 buyers at about 12,400, so 49,600 rupees.

segments.title: Mom Said Get Off the Couch
segments.text: Next, Mom Said Get Off the Couch. Students get eight classes at twenty per cent off, in the off-peak hours when the studio is practically theirs. Mum will be thrilled. The plan is 7 buyers at about 7,000, so 48,800 rupees.

segments.title: Group Project (Finally, Everyone Pulls Their Weight)
segments.text: Then, Group Project, where finally, everyone pulls their weight. Squads of four students buying together each get twenty-five per cent off, off-peak only. Free-loaders still have to do the planks. The plan is 5 buyers at about 6,500, so 32,700 rupees.

segments.title: Don't Ghost Us After the Party
segments.text: And finally, for April's new friends, Don't Ghost Us After the Party. Show up eight times this month, and your next renewal costs less, plus a private on us. Great party. Now the real test. The plan is 12 buyers at about 22,000, so 2.64 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: ≈20% effective on 3M, ≈20% on 1M with the private

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, student offers go live in the quiet afternoon hours. Week two, Mother's Day duos, gifts wrapped, tissues on standby. Week three, every April joiner is tracked towards eight classes. Week four, squads of four close their group buys.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's May at Kenkere House. 11.3 lakh rupees, four offers, and 57 buyers to welcome. Quiet hours, filled. Party guests, kept. That's a good May.
